name: bipolar-support
description: Arrange weekly commitments, inspect overlaps and compare time budgets.

interface.longDescription: Arrange weekly commitments, inspect overlaps and compare time budgets. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Build a weekly commitment list; Find overlapping commitments; Compare category totals with your time budgets. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring. General personal and project organization. Uses only supplied task, project or schedule data. No healthcare records, clinical scoring, treatment, background reminders or external account access.
defaultPrompt: Help me build a weekly commitment list.

prompts: Help me build a weekly commitment list.
Help me compare category totals with your time budgets.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Week Weave: Schedule Planner workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Build a weekly commitment list. Reproducible inputs: {"commitments":[{"day":"Monday","start":"09:00","duration_minutes":60,"activity":"Design review"},{"day":"Monday","start":"09:30","duration_minutes":45,"activity":"Team planning"}]}
positive.prompt: Help me build a weekly commitment list with these supplied values: {"commitments":[{"day":"Monday","start":"09:00","duration_minutes":60,"activity":"Design review"},{"day":"Monday","start":"09:30","duration_minutes":45,"activity":"Team planning"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses week_weave_weekly_commitments with the supplied inputs. Returns {"schedule":[{"day":"Monday","start":"09:00","duration_minutes":60,"activity":"Design review","finish":"10:00"},{"day":"Monday","start":"09:30","duration_minutes":45,"activity":"Team planning","finish":"10:15"}],"total_minutes":105}. Shows the actual calendar result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Find overlapping commitments. Reproducible inputs: {"commitments":[{"day":"Tuesday","start":"10:00","duration_minutes":60,"activity":"Workshop"},{"day":"Tuesday","start":"10:45","duration_minutes":30,"activity":"Delivery window"}]}
positive.prompt: Help me find overlapping commitments with these supplied values: {"commitments":[{"day":"Tuesday","start":"10:00","duration_minutes":60,"activity":"Workshop"},{"day":"Tuesday","start":"10:45","duration_minutes":30,"activity":"Delivery window"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses week_weave_schedule_overlaps with the supplied inputs. Returns {"overlaps":[{"day":"Tuesday","first":"Workshop","second":"Delivery window","overlap_minutes":15}],"has_conflicts":true}. Shows the actual checklist result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Compare category totals with your time budgets. Reproducible inputs: {"categories":[{"category":"Study","budget_minutes":300,"planned_minutes":360},{"category":"Home projects","budget_minutes":180,"planned_minutes":120}]}
positive.prompt: Help me compare category totals with your time budgets with these supplied values: {"categories":[{"category":"Study","budget_minutes":300,"planned_minutes":360},{"category":"Home projects","budget_minutes":180,"planned_minutes":120}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses week_weave_weekly_time_budget with the supplied inputs. Returns {"categories":[{"category":"Study","budget_minutes":300,"planned_minutes":360,"remaining_minutes":-60,"over_budget":true},{"category":"Home projects","budget_minutes":180,"planned_minutes":120,"remaining_minutes":60,"over_budget":false}],"budget_total":480,"planned_total":480}. Shows the actual bars result. Does not fabricate external data.

Reserve a room for each scheduled event.

review.commerce_description: No payments, orders, purchases or external account changes.

publication.release_notes: 0.3.1: Replaces former healthcare workflows with nonmedical personal/project planning operations. Compact native host task surfaces. Five tools, labeled examples, versioned documents and recoverable validation.
